findings.finding: Alvin is a real published 3D alveolar/gas-exchange project. Its repository declares GPL-3.0 and has FBX Git-LFS assets, but a mesh-specific attribution/reuse chain separate from the application and third-party notices was not established. No CC license inferred for the meshes. GPL is not a noncommercial license; this is unresolved asset licensing, not a claim that GPL forbids reuse.
findings.nextAction: Clarify upstream mesh provenance and asset license, or use an explicit CC BY/SA scientific alveolar asset.
findings.scope: Bounded documented source audit, not a claim of worldwide nonexistence.
